verdict.rationale: Persona documents a Hosted Flow (redirect to a Persona page, no frontend code), an Embedded Flow (iframe or modal) and Mobile SDKs. Inquiries can be pre-created server-side via the API, and inquiry templates define the screens and verifications. Government ID plus Selfie verification is a documented combination, and results can be read by polling the API or through webhooks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end doc-plus-selfie hosted or embedded integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a complete document-plus-selfie verification with a hosted or drop-in flow — create a session server-side, redirect or embed, and read the result — without building capture UI myself

citations.quote: **Hosted Flow** | Redirect users to a Persona-hosted page | Fastest setup, no frontend code required
Embedded Flow | Persona UI embedded in your page via iframe or modal | Seamless UX on your site
Pre-creating Inquiries: Use the API to pre-create inquiries before directing users through the inquiry flow for information collection and verification.
Inquiry templates house the configuration for a single use case by defining the screens, verifications, decisioning, and theming.
This is especially useful when combined with a Government ID Verification
Poll the API for the latest inquiry statuses or fetch specific verification details without disrupting your primary integration.
Set up webhooks to receive real-time status updates when a user is approved, declined, or requires further review.
